notes: Adds live Heading and Speed status; speed is always displayed in m/s and may come from NMEA STW/Speed Log, OBD-II USB Vehicle Speed, or Manual Test Speed.
Adds three simultaneous position cards: DRP (Doctor Boat Position Calculator), raw GNSS, and Fusion Sensor position.
Fusion position remains WAITING until a real fusion-position input is supplied; no synthetic fusion value is fabricated.
Adds automatic GNSS integrity gate for DRP: raw GNSS remains logged/displayed while unreasonable jumps are rejected from DRP.
Hard GNSS jump protection at >500 m plus speed/time plausibility checking.
At near-zero measured speed, normal GNSS wander is prevented from moving DRP.
When GNSS is rejected/lost, DRP continues from last accepted position using selected speed, heading and elapsed time.
Retains numbered dynamic grids, four fixed reference points per grid, angle/radial visualization, historical grids, track, pan/zoom and session logging.
